o.text: Probably from göz (“eye”) + -ter/tər, a fossilized form of the causativity suffix -dir. Compare Turkish göstermek and Crimean Tatar göstermek (southern dialect), Crimean Tatar köstermek (northern dialect). Compare also Azerbaijani görsətmək.
Borrowed from Classical Persian جَامَهشور (jāma-šōr), a vulgar variant of جَامَهشویْ (jāma-šōy). Compare Turkish çamaşır.
